dedupe_keys.name: data linz gv at public transport datasets

description: data.linz.gv.at: public transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data.linz.gv.at. Coverage: the area served by data.linz.gv.at. The listing groups 8 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about public transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Haltestellen der LINZ AG LINIEN 2014 (Linz); Haltestellen der LINZ AG LINIEN 2015 (Linz); Linien, Fahrwege und Haltestellen der LINZ AG LINIEN 2020 - Dokumentat; Haltestellen der LINZ AG LINIEN 2020 (Linz). Formats seen: GML, PDF, XML, MDB. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
